_comment: CSS selectors for SSA.gov retirement pages. quick_calculator selectors VERIFIED 2026-06-10 against the live site via CI (actions run 27248526562). The plain-HTML Quick Calculator has been stable for years.

quick_calculator._comment_dob: Three separate text inputs — month (dobmon), day (dobday), year (yob)
quick_calculator._comment_earnings: Current-year earnings; if 0, form reveals lastYearEarn + lastEarn
quick_calculator._comment_retire: Optional planned retirement — both month and year required
quick_calculator._comment_dollars: Radio: value=1 → today's dollars (default/checked); value=0 → inflated (future) dollars
quick_calculator._comment_results: Results page — verified working 2026-06-10 via live CI run

retirement_application._comment: Intentionally empty. The previous selectors here were fabricated — the live run on 2026-06-10 proved they do not exist on secure.ssa.gov/iClaim/rib. The application tool is now a pure human handoff (Login.gov / ID.me) and needs no selectors.

life_expectancy._comment: VERIFIED 2026-06-10 from live form HTML (CI run 27268573761). Plain POST form; month values are 0-based; day list is JS-populated after month selection.

office_locator._comment: Entry-page selectors probed 2026-06-10 (CI run 27268573761): secure.ssa.gov/ICON redirects to www.ssa.gov/locator. Results-page selectors are best-effort.
